pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of grid averaging or adding positions into moving market wicks; pyramiding is only authorized if the initial position is in profit by at least 1.5R and volatility is compressing.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero execution permitted within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic news releases, and order entry requires simultaneous multi-timeframe ATR expansion confirmation.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instant trailing stop activation at +$5.00 unrealized profit to guarantee a minimum risk-reward profile and prevent green runs from evaporating.
